scrollArea.$description: ScrollArea's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--scroll-area-<name>) on the page, a container or one ScrollArea, and every ScrollArea inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

thumb.$description: The scrollbar's thumb (3:1 on the surface).

focus-ring.$description: The ring inside its edge while it has focus.

fade.$description: How far an edge with more past it fades, with fade (32px).
